question: Does the HCMUS tissue-engineering laboratory (Tran Le Bao Ha) still work on cultivated meat, and does it have any peer-reviewed output, funding or industry partner since the 2022 announcement?
why_it_matters: It is the only Vietnam-direct cultivated-meat laboratory we found; its status decides whether T8 has a credible domestic host beyond VAST and Vinmec.
cheapest_way_to_close: Email or call the laboratory at the University of Science, VNU-HCM; search Vietnamese theses and the lab publication list.
owner_org_to_ask: University of Science, VNU-HCM (tissue-engineering and biomedical-materials laboratory)

question: Could a Vietnamese scaffold biomaterial (coconut bacterial cellulose, textured soy, shrimp-shell chitosan) be qualified as a food-grade cultivated-meat scaffold, and is there any buyer abroad?
why_it_matters: It is the only cultivated-meat input where Vietnam has a raw material; a buyer specification would be the first sign of an export-ingredient angle.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask cultivated-meat scaffold firms (Matrix Meats, Excell) and GFI APAC for material specifications; check food-grade status of bacterial-cellulose functionalisation.

question: Could VNU-HCM Pichia-expressed growth factors (FGF-2, KGF, PDGF-BB) be food-graded and sold B2B into cultivated-meat media?
why_it_matters: It is Vietnam’s only transferable media input; feeds RM-14 and tests whether any cultivated supply role exists, though the buyer market is small and shrinking.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the VNU-HCM group about food-grade production cost and purity; ask cultivated-media firms (Multus, Merck) about specifications.
owner_org_to_ask: University of Science, VNU-HCM; cultivated-media suppliers
